item.description:
I’m excited to see the release of the Essay Architecture book from the work of Michael Dean. As he says, there are no other works that teach you to write. This could be an important book to a lot of people. Knowing how to write well will become more important even as AI may do much of your writing. Writing is a process of structuring your thoughts. AI can’t think for you, and therefore can’t write for you. It must be a collaborative process, or you’ll never develop the ability to do either. Instead, you’ll turn into a bot.

  • Essay Architecture

Bookmarked under “people to pay attention to.”

Cathie Wood is the founder and CEO of Ark Invest. She manages billions, and she is someone to pay attention to.
